paper.title: Questioning the Coverage-Length Metric in Conformal Prediction: When Shorter Intervals Are Not Better

claims.scope: Finite synthetic PT mechanism: 100 rows, 16/16 nontrivial shorter conditions, maximum aggregate coverage error 0.013.
Current source matches clean-room output and bias-10 historical CSV, but the paper's p=0.96 PT value is not exact.
Seven obtainable UCI regressions ran; unavailable datasets and checkpoints are not represented as reruns.
Synthetic PT instability and p=1 controls pass independent checks.
Constructive localized-CP extreme case passes 15 conditions and 1,500,000 retrainings with zero mismatches.
Trained-localizer diagnostic is recorded without making a universal instability claim.

limitations: No theorem proof, complete paper-wide dataset/checkpoint reproduction, external score, or author endorsement is claimed.
The expensive producer suite is represented by committed evidence during final-state verification.
